tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Text on it: ink, ink-muted, brand, green-strong, danger.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, rows, fields and sheets sitting on surface. Same text colors as surface.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet bands, table headers, selected rows, empty states. Text: ink, ink-muted.

tokens.name: surface-fresh
tokens.usage: Background of success and completed states. Text: green-strong, ink.

tokens.name: surface-alert
tokens.usage: Background of error and cancelled states. Text: danger, ink.

tokens.name: surface-gold
tokens.usage: Background of pending and warning states. Text: ink.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on surface, surface-raised, surface-tint and the three status surfaces.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and hints on surface, surface-raised and surface-tint.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The logo navy. Primary buttons, links, selected tabs, focus ring and headings that carry the brand. Text on it: on-brand. Dark theme lightens it so it stays 7:1+ on every surface.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on a brand fill.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: The logo leaf green. Graphics, checkmarks, illustrations and large display shapes only (3.5:1 on white). Never for body text in the light theme: use green-strong.

tokens.name: green-strong
tokens.usage: Green as text or as a button fill: success labels, Add-to-order button. Text on a green-strong fill: on-green-strong. 5.4:1 on surface, 4.9:1 on surface-fresh.

tokens.name: on-green-strong
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on a green-strong fill.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: The logo coin and pepper yellow. Prices highlights, coin motif, warning dots and large decorative fields. Never as text on a light surface (1.7:1). Text on it: on-gold.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text placed on a gold fill (8:1).

tokens.name: tomato
tokens.usage: The logo tomato red. Illustration and small accents (4.8:1 on white). For error text use danger.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text, destructive buttons and cancelled labels. Always paired with a word or icon, never color alone.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text placed on a danger fill.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines between rows and sections. Not for control edges.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, checkboxes and outlined buttons (3:1 or more on every surface).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: أضف الأصناف، وحدد الكميات، واعرف المجموع قبل أن تشتري.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside badges and rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Field padding and gaps between related controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default card padding and page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards and between form groups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing on tablets and desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Large section breaks.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page top margin and hero spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, checkboxes, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, order rows (matches the clipboard corner in the logo).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets and cover blocks.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills and quantity steppers.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Floating cards and the bottom order bar. Flat rows use divider instead.
